steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A good essay has: introduction, 3-4 developed paragraphs, conclusion | Key Fact: The introduction should define key terms and indicate your line of argument | Key Fact: Use PEEL: Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link back to the question | Key Fact: Evidence must be specific — named characters, events, sources and cultural details
